title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
summary: Find the longest strictly increasing subsequence, which need not be contiguous.
statement:
Return the length of the longest **strictly increasing** subsequence of `nums`.

A subsequence keeps the original order but may skip any number of elements — it does not have to be contiguous.

### Constraints

- 1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 100,000
- -10⁹ ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10⁹

> **O(n²) will time out!**

visibleTests.explanation: Strictly increasing, so equal values cannot extend a run.
